Modeled to look exactly like the real thing, these two slender sticks are actually fun bubble blowers. Perfect for pranks, photoshoots, or just breaking the ice at parties, they let you blow whimsical bubbles instead of smoke.

This Complete Kit Includes:

- 2x Realistic Cigarette Bubble Wands: Double the wands for double the fun.

- 1x Authentic-Looking Cigarette Box: Perfect for realistic display, pranks, and storing your wands.

- 1x Bottle of Bubble Liquid: Everything you need to start blowing bubbles right out of the box!
name: Cigarette Package
target_market: Pranksters, Social Media Content Creators, and Party Enthusiasts
